notes: Answered only from documented biography (Wikipedia; Isaacson's authorised 'Steve Jobs'; Reed College; ABC/CNN/Cult of Mac health reporting; DOJ/court records for the antitrust matters; Lisa Brennan-Jobs's 'Small Fry' coverage). Part D omitted - this exercise forbade opening any reading, so no valid answer to D1-D8 exists. Key facts behind the answers: b. 24 Feb 1955 San Francisco, given up at one week and adopted by Paul Jobs (machinist, d. 5 Mar 1993) and Clara Hagopian Jobs (bookkeeper, lung cancer, d. 1986); adoptive sister Patricia adopted 1957; biological parents Joanne Schieble and Abdulfattah Jandali, biological sister Mona Simpson met 1986. A1/A2 - 7:15 pm birth-certificate time is the universally cited figure; because it falls on an exact quarter hour I chose 'to_15' rather than 'exact'; A3 'no' because no rectification is on record (I did NOT consult any astrological source; the time is treated purely as a documentary fact). A4/A5 - at least the July 2004 Whipple pancreaticoduodenectomy and the 2009 Memphis liver transplant, plus a documented post-transplant infection admission and repeated 2011 hospitalisations, hence 'four_plus'/'two_plus'. A6 - pancreatic neuroendocrine tumour with liver metastases (stomach/digestion + liver); 'kidney_urinary' because the October 2003 CT that found the tumour was ordered by his urologist for a urinary-tract follow-up after kidney-stone history - that is the weakest of the three. A7/A8 - no childhood illness is recorded and he is described as a hyperactive, physically fine child, so 'robust'; 'yes' to early danger rests on Isaacson's account of the toddler Jobs burning his hand on an electrical socket and being rushed to hospital after ingesting ant poison - I could not re-verify that specific passage in an independent source before my search budget ran out, so treat A8 as the least-supported item here. A9 - genuinely undocumented for either the adoptive or the biological grandparents; 'unknown' is honest, not lazy. A11 'steady' - Paul Jobs held machinist/repossession work through the 1950s-60s and the family stayed in the Mountain View house; no reversal is documented, though money was tight. A13 - 'close' reflects the very well-documented bond with Mona Simpson (she delivered his eulogy); his relationship with Patty is barely documented and appears distant, so this answer is really about one sibling not both. A14/A15 - Homestead High graduate 1972, Reed College one semester (dropped out Dec 1972, audited classes incl. calligraphy until 1974), never graduated, hence 'higher_secondary' + 'serious' interruption. A19 - contested: some biographers argue he took credit due to Wozniak, Jef Raskin and others, others that his recognition matched his output; 'about_right' avoids asserting the contested claim. A20 'some' - he lived and worked his whole adult life within about 45 miles of his birthplace, though Apple/Pixar revenue was global. A21 'net_gain' - not betting or lottery but equity: he sold nearly all Apple stock in 1985 (a large hindsight loss), then the Nov 1995 Pixar IPO made him a billionaire and the 2006 Disney deal left him Disney's largest individual shareholder (~7%). A22 'none' - no inheritance or windfall of significance is documented. A23 'none' - no personal debt trouble; NeXT losses were equity he funded himself. A24-A27 - married Laurene Powell 18 Mar 1991 at the Ahwahnee, Yosemite, at 36 (late by his family's pattern), marriage intact at his death. A28/A29 - four children: Lisa Brennan-Jobs (17 May 1978, paternity denied under oath, 1980 child-support suit, DNA 94.4%, reconciled later but the relationship stayed difficult), Reed (1991), Erin (1995), Eve (1998); no documented conception difficulty or loss of a child. A30 - Isaacson and colleagues document outspoken/brutally blunt, legendary temper, bold risk-taking, and a genuine philosophical/Zen streak; 'patient', 'cautious' and 'reserved' are all contradicted. A31 'brief' - primal-scream therapy under Janov's method in the mid-1970s and a documented depressed spell after the 1985 ouster; no diagnosed illness or sustained psychiatric treatment on record. A32 'central' - India pilgrimage 1974, lifelong Zen practice under Kobun Chino Otogawa (who officiated his wedding), Buddhist funeral. A33 'over5' - Portland 1972-74 and roughly seven months in India 1974 mean 'abroad' is also literally true, but decades away from San Francisco proper is the dominant fact. A34 'extended' - two years living on/around the Reed campus plus multi-week hospital stays in 2004, 2009 (Memphis) and 2011. A35 - 12-row cap forced omissions; also documented and dateable: Apple II Apr 1977, Macintosh launch 24 Jan 1984, Apple's Sept 1985 suit against him over NeXT (settled Jan 1986), Pixar bought Feb 1986, Paul Jobs's death Mar 1993, iPod Oct 2001, diagnosis Oct 2003, the 2006-07 options-backdating investigation (SEC declined to charge him), Disney/Pixar deal 2006, iPhone Jun 2007, iPad Jan 2010, final medical leave Jan 2011, resignation 24 Aug 2011, death 5 Oct 2011 (tumour-related respiratory arrest, Palo Alto), posthumous Presidential Medal of Freedom 2022. A35#12 uses 2009-03 for the liver transplant per Isaacson (21 Mar 2009); much contemporaneous reporting says April 2009 - a genuine one-month source conflict. A36 - he died in 2011, so both windows are posthumous; 'same' is the only non-misleading choice and should be read as not-applicable. B1 opt1 - the critical, flaw-spotting, impossible-to-satisfy pole is far better attested than the pride/recognition pole, though both partly fit. B2 - about 6 ft 2 in and consistently thin. B3 'younger' - repeatedly described as boyish in his twenties and thirties; the gaunt illness years cut the other way, so this is a weak item. B4 'eldest' - eldest in both his adoptive family (Patricia, 1957) and his biological one (Mona, 1957). C2 opt2 - partnership is the sharpest negative in his record: ousted in 1985 by his own hand-picked CEO after a failed boardroom coup, Wayne walked out in 1976, the Wozniak friendship cooled; set against strong later collaborations (Ive, Lasseter, Cook), hence confidence 3 not 5. C7 opt2 - the father in his lived life was Paul Jobs, whom he revered and who shaped his craftsmanship; the biological-father wound (he refused to meet Jandali) is why confidence is only 3. C10 confidence 2 - no ear or throat trouble is documented at all; 'gone well' is inferred from absence, not evidence. C12 opt1 - warm family life in the modest Palo Alto house, offset by the long-running Woodside mansion demolition litigation (permit 2004, demolished 2011) and years living in a famously unfurnished house. Other documented legal/reputational history not captured by any question: the 2006-07 stock-option backdating investigation; the e-book price-fixing conspiracy he initiated in 2010 (US v. Apple, $450m/$400m settlements after his death); the Silicon Valley no-poach wage-fixing case in which court filings named him the instigator ($415m settlement, 2015); National Medal of Technology 1985.
